summarize_collated_reports: summarize the python module to collate pytest short summary reports across model directories into a single JSON file
run_parse_short_summary_line: run parse_short_summary_line to extract test status and count from a pytest short summary line
run_get_gpu_name: run get_gpu_name to detect or simplify the GPU name from torch or command-line argument
run_upload_collated_report: run upload_collated_report to upload a collated JSON report to a HuggingFace dataset repository
run_get_arguments: run get_arguments to parse CLI arguments and return an Args dataclass with validated path and GPU info
